node.statement: The premises of the preceding conditional are unavailable here. def-hcb-datum expressly packages only data and notation and supplies no Ruan scalar/direct-sum axioms or isometric zero-corner maps; def-ha-map defines only the level-one Ha map. The allowed amplified-adjointness and product-defect lemmas assert identities/estimates at each fixed n but no functorial relation between different n. Thus neither the two isometries nor h_m i=j h_n follows from any allowed input, so the earlier unconditional conclusion is withdrawn and parent 1.3 retains a genuine dependency gap.
